problem: Low user traction after about three years.
title: Google shuts down Stadia and refunds purchases
context: Google's cloud game streaming service Stadia had not gained the traction the company expected.
action_taken: Announced in September 2022 with refunds for hardware and game purchases; Stadia Pro subscriptions were not refunded.
observed_outcome: The service ended as scheduled. Google said the underlying technology could be used in other products.
observation_period: About 4 months from announcement to closure
lessons: Refunding purchases can soften the impact of a shutdown, but a public statement that a product is not closing erodes trust if it closes soon after.
limitations: Google had said in July 2022 that Stadia was not shutting down. Financial results were not established.

claims.claim_text: Google announced Stadia would shut down on 18 January 2023 and refund hardware and game purchases.
Google said Stadia had not gained the expected traction with users.
